description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_URI, which validates and sanitizes URIs used within CSS 'url()' syntax, extending base URI validation with additional checks specific to CSS syntax.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_URI
classes.description: A class that validates CSS URIs embedded within CSS syntax, ensuring correct formatting and sanitization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the URI validation object, always with embedded mode enabled.

methods.name: validate
